TITLE: Cross-regime relation register
PURPOSE: Documents how the results of Regimes A, B, and C may coexist without creating any new inference: which relations already exist under a ruling, which items may only be placed side by side, which relations need a ruling that does not exist, and which are prohibited. Restates and organizes the S0 rules; it creates no authority.
NOT_A_FINDING: This register is documentation. It adds no evidence, authorizes no relation, and does not raise the force of any claim.

CATEGORIES.AUTHORIZED_EXISTING_RELATION: A relation already authorized in the ledgers before LAB-S (a LAB-GOV ruling or a pre-registered hypothesis), valid only inside its own claim and scope. Called AUTHORIZED_PRE_EXISTING in the S0 registry.
CATEGORIES.JUXTAPOSITION_ONLY: Items may be placed adjacent, each with its own state, scope, limitations, and provenance, with no shared axis, derived metric, or connective language implying support, explanation, or consistency.
CATEGORIES.GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED: Would need an explicit LAB-GOV ruling (Charter section 19 rule 3) before being asserted. Marked only; no ruling is created here.
CATEGORIES.PROHIBITED: Not to be asserted or implied by LAB-S in any form.

RULES_APPLIED: reports/lab_s/LAB-S0-synthesis-rules.json (DEC-001 to DEC-006, AUTH, JX, PR, GR); synthesis gate rules 1 to 6; the LAB-GOV rulings already in the registry.

RELATIONS.TITLE: SIPA and ARCA inside LAB-CLM-0007 (Monotributo share)

RULE_OR_RULING.NOTE: Authorizes SIPA's three dependent modalities as a LAB-analytical-only denominator component for LAB-HYP-0005's 'formal dependent registration' term.

INDEPENDENCE.BASIS: Ruling section F and LAB-CLM-0007's LINEAGE_INDEPENDENCE: same underlying SUSS/ARCA declaration stream. The lineage registry lists LAB-ROOT-0007 and LAB-ROOT-0001 each as INDEPENDENT in its own right; that does not override the ruling or the claim.

RELATIONS.PERMITTED_COMPARISON: The computation recorded in LAB-CLM-0007, exactly as written and inside that claim: the Monotributo share of ARCA Monotributista counts plus SIPA's ASALARIADO_PRIVADO, ASALARIADO_PUBLICO, and CASAS_PARTICULARES modalities as a LAB-analytical denominator component, with the Mixtos overlap, the GOV-005 caveat, and the cross-sectional limits disclosed. The SIPA side is a denominator component, never SIPA's own TOTAL.
RELATIONS.PROHIBITED_INFERENCE: Treating SIPA and ARCA as two independent Evidence Roots; CONVERGENT or ESTABLISHED_WITHIN_SCOPE for LAB-CLM-0007; reading agreement with any SIPA-only claim as corroboration; using the substitution outside LAB-CLM-0007; merging LAB-OBJ-0016, LAB-OBJ-0006, and LAB-OBJ-0013, which remain distinct ledger objects.
RELATIONS.REASON: The ruling governs this one use and states, in its section F, that using SIPA directly removes a republication circularity but does not make SIPA and ARCA independent of each other for Root Counting: both trace to the same SUSS/ARCA declaration stream, so no CONVERGENT claim is or could be authorized. It is the only cross-regime reuse of a root that the ledgers govern.
RELATIONS.ROOT_ORIGIN_NOTE: LAB-ROOT-0001 (SIPA) was admitted for Regime A and carries LAB-CLM-0001 and LAB-CLM-0003; here it is used inside a Regime B claim. The context claims are listed only to locate the root and are not part of the authorized relation.
